title: Replies in the owner's native language
what: The "Working with me" text in relay says, softly, that the front answers the owner in the owner's native language; the model detects it or asks once directly. Code, file names, commits and project docs stay English; the owner's words are recorded verbatim. Where the native language is known it is kept as a user fact so detection does not depend on the language of each message.
why: The owner, verbatim: "My native lang is russian - I don't like speak in English"; then "a - can we fix this in relay, but not hard rules, use native language term for this, model can detect or ask directly".
